rawStatement: I spent 20 minutes looking for a picture of a receipt I took at a restaurant in Austin last year, but I couldn't remember the date or the name of the place, just that it had a yellow table.
Google photos search is so frustrating sometimes. I know I have a screenshot of a book recommendation, but searching 'book' or 'text' brings up thousands of things.
I wish I could search by feelings. I have a photo from a rainy day where I felt super cozy and drinking tea, but searching 'tea' doesn't find it.
